title: I'm publishing FREE, geopolitical news refiner. It also analyses on the big geopolitical markets — refreshed twice a day.
author: MVPtonight
selftext:
Hey guys,

It's been a while i'm working on this project and I think i found it an utility. It started as a geopolitical news refiner. You fetch a lot of journals, read articles, transform that into events and then synthesis what is happening in the world. Many cool features for example some events are cover my lots of media so you can really see the semantic difference and how each media has its opinion.

Anyway, once you have an event database + narratives + Qwen/Claude to analyze it all, what do you naturally do ? You start asking it questions ! And so I plugged World-Observer into the Polymarket API.

Now, for a geopolitical market (say "US–Iran permanent peace deal by June 30?"), the system pulls the events actually related to that question and has Claude write an analysis of the bet, an estimated probability, the case for and against, and every claim traced back to a dated source event. 100% transparent, you see exactly which events drove the call and can tell me where it's wrong.

The core is free. For the main geopolitical markets, these Claude analyses get refreshed twice a day, for everyone — no signup, no paywall. I have yet to decide the exact hours, I will have to check the busiest hours and do refresh after this.

Let's be straight: I'm not claiming an edge over the market. It's a fast, auditable second opinion grounded in real events. And since "trust me" is worthless here, every estimate is logged with a timestamp before resolution, and I'll publish the calibration as markets resolve — performance vs. the market, misses included. Track record in the open. I'm not gonna lie this part is still getting build as I've yet to spend some time deciding how to correctly do this and be representative.

The only paid part: if you want to go off-script and run the analysis on your own question, or on a predictive market question but you want your own hypotheses and your own hand-picked sample of events. That fires a live model call, so it costs a few cents in credits. Not really sustainable for me to let this free.

Everything standard stays free. Honestly I'm here because i'm super existed by this project and I think I need some feedback: is the reasoning any good? what would make it actually useful at the table?

Thank you for reading all this, try a go at : [www.world-observer.com](http://www.world-observer.com)

PS: I had not time to work on the mobile version. It's functionnal but I would expect few issues.
